items.stem: What is the ratio of 5 rupees to 80 paise?

What is the simplest form of the ratio 60:40?

What is the simplest form of the ratio 2 kg to 800 grams?

A goods train covers 240 km in 4 hours. How much distance will it cover in 7 hours?

A school wanted to purchase 50 saplings for planting trees on the occasion of Environment Day. The school purchased 35 saplings from 'Yashoda' nursery for ₹455 and the remaining saplings from 'Amol' nursery for ₹240. From which nursery will the school get the saplings purchased at low price?
Michael's monthly income of ₹52,000 out of which he saves ₹13,000 monthly. Then find the ratio of his monthly income to his expenditure.

If the cost of 10 compass boxes is ₹850, what will be the cost of 67 compass boxes?
